items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 61:1
items.html: The name HaVaYaH is ten Sefirot: YHV are KHB, and VH are ZON, as is known. And it is not yet known from this from which stature these ten Sefirot are — whether in the stature of Nefesh, Ruach, Neshama, etc. And for this come the fillings, which explain the ten Sefirot in the HaVaYaH from the aspect of the measure of the stature in them: in the stature of Nefesh they are filled with Heis, which is in Gematria 52 (BON); in the stature of Ruach they are filled with Alephs, which is in Gematria 45 (MA); in the stature of Neshama they are filled with Yuds, except for the Vav in it, which is filled with an Aleph, being in Gematria 63 (SAG); and in the stature of Chaya it is filled entirely with Yuds, even in its Vav, which is in Gematria 72 (AB). (Page 313, Item 41; and Etz Chaim, Gate 18, Chapter 1).
